founder.headline: Lissette Moody, *DNP*, APRN-C
founder.body:
Lissette Moody is a doctorally prepared, board-certified adult nurse practitioner. She has been a registered nurse since 2006 and a nurse practitioner since 2011, with experience in primary care, transitional care, and inpatient settings. Her clinical focus includes women's health, preventive care, and chronic disease management.

She founded Premier Wellness Telehealth with the belief that every patient deserves to feel heard. Too often, care feels hurried. Here, you'll have the time to share your concerns, ask questions, and understand your options. 

Her approach centers on compassion, attentive listening, patient education, and shared decision-making. Your care plan is personalized to your needs and your goals. 

Premier Wellness Telehealth provides care to adults in Arizona, Florida, Virginia, and Washington State.

testimonial.body: Lissette Moody is a great nurse practitioner. She is compassionate, respectful and knowledgeable. During my visit with her she took time to listen to my concerns and not once did she make me feel like she was in a rush to finish my appointment. I would highly recommend her.
